guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat governance profile selection as a visible plan choice only; calibration and activation remain separate workflows.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep all human-facing decision chrome in exact-parity locale resources and preserve machine facts verbatim.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not add commit, push, PR, merge, successful-branch deletion, or package-manager behavior.
